config.lumispheric.title: Lumispheric Settings
config.lumispheric.tooltip.sunset_intens: Adjusts the warm tint around the Sun at sunrise and sunset.
config.lumispheric.tooltip.mie_intensity: Controls the soft atmospheric halo around the Sun.
config.lumispheric.tooltip.latitude: Adjusts the apparent path of celestial bodies.
config.lumispheric.tooltip.celestial_siz: Changes the size of the Sun and Moon, from 25% to 100% of vanilla.
config.lumispheric.tooltip.milky_way_bri: Adjusts the brightness of the Milky Way band.
config.lumispheric.tooltip.cloud_distanc: Extends cloud render distance; lower values reduce that extension.
